svg.title: Regional coverage of WaaV providers
svg.desc: A world map. Tinted countries are home to regional speech providers integrated in WaaV: Europe, Russia, India, China, Korea and Japan, Vietnam and Thailand. Cards list each region's providers and languages; twenty global cloud vendors cover the rest.

g.text: 44 vendors behind one API: the global clouds, plus regional specialists for the languages, accents and dialects they know best.
Deepgram · OpenAI · Google · Microsoft Azure · AWS · ElevenLabs · AssemblyAI · Cartesia · IBM Watson · Groq
Rev AI · Hume · Resemble · Speechify · WellSaid · Murf · Unreal Speech · Inworld · Ultravox · xAI Grok
Map: Natural Earth (public domain). Tinted: where a regional provider comes from. 31 speech-to-text, 34 text-to-speech and 11 speech-to-speech integrations.
